verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says you can restore any previous checkpoint from version history. Linear also documents cloud coding sessions run by Linear Agent. However, the checkpoint snippet never says it applies to coding-agent sessions rather than another artifact, such as agent-edited documents. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that checkpoints apply to coding-agent sessions, detail on what a restore reverts (code, environment, conversation), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history

citations.quote: If you need to revert to an earlier version, restore to any previous checkpoint from version history.
Coding sessions run in the cloud, so you can prototype ideas and make changes without setting up a local development environment.
